argv:
set -u
R=$(ls -d /tmp/tameshi-r16-rg.*)
E=.ufo/evidence/round-16/round-gate; P=$E/survivor-probes/probes.mjs
X=/tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR44-Ez7Ttp/probes; rm -rf "$X"; mkdir -p "$X"
sha256sum "$R/work/pristine.round-gate.mjs" "$R/work/mutant-A2.round-gate.mjs" "$R/work/mutant-B2.round-gate.mjs" "$R/work/mutant-E1.round-gate.mjs" | cut -c1-16,65-
run() { # id probe gate tag
  GATE="$3" FXROOT="$X/fx-$1-$2-$4" node "$P" "$2" > "$X/$1-$2-$4.log" 2>&1; local rc=$?
  echo "$1 $2 $4 exit=$rc :: $(grep -m1 '^## ' "$X/$1-$2-$4.log")"
}
for sp in A2:P1 A2:P1b B2:P6 E1:P9; do id=${sp%%:*}; pr=${sp#*:}
  run "$id" "$pr" "$R/work/pristine.round-gate.mjs" pristine
  run "$id" "$pr" "$R/work/mutant-$id.round-gate.mjs" mutant
done
echo "## C1059: c1059-probe.sh (case note §4; writes its two logs beside itself in this /tmp clone)"
bash "$E/survivor-probes/c1059-probe.sh" > "$X/c1059.stdout" 2> "$X/c1059.stderr"; echo "c1059-probe.sh exit=$?"
grep -E '^(exit=|ROUND_GATE)' "$E/survivor-probes/c1059-pristine.log" | sed 's/^/pristine: /'
grep -E '^(exit=|ROUND_GATE)' "$E/survivor-probes/c1059-mutant.log" | sed 's/^/mutant:   /'
